items.title: Harold Ousley interviewed by Monk Rowe, New York City, New York, January 12, 2001
items.q: He has performed and recorded with Count Basie, Dinah Washington, Machito and Brother Jack McDuff.

ctx.x: Saxophonist Harold Ousley was born in Chicago on January 23, 1929. He has performed and recorded with Count Basie, Dinah Washington, Machito and Brother Jack McDuff. Harold is a prolific songwriter and is currently active with the Jazz Mobile and productions for cable television Harold was interviewed in New York City on January 12, 2001, by Monk Rowe, Director of the Hamilton College Jazz Archive.
My name is Monk Rowe and we are filming in New York City for the Hamilton College Jazz Archive. I’m quite pleased to have Harold Ousley with me this morning. Thank you for getting up so early.
